message.content:
Sure! The “seamless” line is specifically engineered to avoid the traditional three‑line seam construction you’ll find on most regular trousers. Instead, the fabric is either woven or knitted in such a way that the edges are either invisible or sealed with a very subtle flat‑lock stitch that’s almost imperceptible from the outside. In short, you won’t see the classic three‑seam pattern—just a smooth, continuous surface. 

If you’re looking at a particular brand or style and want to double‑check the exact seam treatment, let me know the name/model and I can give you a more detailed rundown.
